name: ropensci/ramlegacy
description: R :package: to download, cache and read in different versions of the RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Data Base, an online compilation of stock assessment results for commercially exploited marine populations from around the world.
score_rationale: Useful marine fisheries reference package for accessing a standard stock-assessment database, though it is older and less actively maintained than the top anchors.
category: Marine Biology — ocean monitoring, fisheries, coral reef analysis
